layercake_native_host.claim_boundary: LayerCake outperforms the locked optimized transformer on the certified matched scope. This is not a universal transformer-dominance claim and does not prove the broader 28-prompt ABI English-transfer gate.

abi_source_artifact.claim_boundary: Adequacy proves runtime evidence, prompt-bound correctness, coverage, provenance, and segregation. It does not prove that the artifact contains enough information to train a general English payload.

abi_to_layercake_acquisition.measured_blocker: Insufficient natural instruction and prompt-grounding breadth in the adequate but compact V71 artifact; not a LayerCake execution, ABI transport, teacher-removal, topology, or source-block-elimination failure.

integrated_product.reason: No ABI payload passes the quality screen, so shuffled-artifact causality, full teacher-relative quality, CPU throughput, cold TTFT, RSS, and three-seed promotion remain ineligible.

bottom_line: LayerCake's locked native execution advantage remains proven. ABI now proves source adequacy, exact compatible-weight extraction, complete accounting, source removal, source-block conformance, and bit-exact installation, but it has not proved generation-quality knowledge transfer. Current failures belong to ABI acquisition quality, not LayerCake.
